scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a seven-day Bali trip, [X] assigns interchangeable lower garments to humid everyday sightseeing, beach and water time, temple visits requiring knee coverage, and a possible sunrise hike instead of expecting one bottom to serve every part of the itinerary.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在为期七天的巴厘岛行程中，[X]会分别为湿热天气下的日常游览、海滩与水上活动、要求遮盖膝部的寺庙参访，以及可能安排的日出徒步配置可替换的下装，而不是期待同一条下装应付全部环节。
examples: using Beach or Vacation for shoreline, swimming, and resort portions of the trip
using Outdoor for rice-terrace, waterfall, or sunrise-trek days that demand freer movement and more protection
rejecting a beach-only bottom for temple visits where the knees must be covered

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across a five-day Hurghada plan, [X] separates lower-body roles for beach relaxation and snorkeling, a dusty desert safari, an old-town visit with more coverage, and the flights home while keeping the packing list affordable and compact.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在五天的赫尔格达行程中，[X]会区分海滩休闲与浮潜、尘土较多的沙漠活动、需要更多遮盖的老城参访，以及返程飞行所需的下装角色，同时控制行李体积和预算。
examples: using Beach for sand, boat, and snorkeling periods where a quick change matters
using Outdoor for the quad-bike and desert portion where coverage and dust protection matter
using Vacation for a compact lower-body capsule that can transition between the resort, town, and airport

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After the groomsmen select army-toned tailoring, [X] uses the ceremony's formal dress code to decide whether the chosen outfit needs full evening treatment and aligns its trousers, shoes, belt, and other shared details with the groom's decision.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 伴郎团已经选定军绿色系的成套正装后，[X]会依据婚礼的正式着装要求，判断这套已选服装是否需要完整晚装规格，并让裤装、鞋、腰带及其他统一细节遵循新郎最终确定的方案。
examples: using Party for a formal marriage ceremony and reception
keeping the selected trousers at the same formality level as the wedding party's tailoring
checking group instructions before treating personal accessory freedom as permission to change the occasion

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a fifteen-day relaxation trip across Swiss lake towns and alpine bases, [X] divides a small lower-body capsule among long train and boat rides, windy lakeside walks, cooler mountain viewpoints, rainy days, and places where more modest coverage is expected.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备在瑞士湖区城镇与阿尔卑斯山区进行十五天的休闲旅行时，[X]会把精简的下装胶囊衣橱分配给长途火车与游船、风大的湖边步行、较冷的山地观景、雨天，以及需要更得体遮盖的场所。
examples: using Vacation for pieces that tolerate repeated train travel and limited laundry
using Outdoor for lake paths and mountain viewpoints with wind, rain, and changing temperatures
rejecting a narrow single-setting choice when the same capsule must also work in towns and churches

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an optometrist appointment in near-freezing weather, [X] needs an interchangeable lower-body option that supports a polished face-focused outfit, warmth on the walk, and comfortable seated frame try-ons without turning the appointment into a formal event.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在接近冰点天气中的验光配镜预约里，[X]需要一类可替换的下装：既能配合突出面部与镜框的利落造型，也能应对步行保暖和坐着反复试戴，同时不把普通预约穿成正式活动。
examples: using Daily for a polished but ordinary personal appointment
keeping the lower silhouette quiet around statement frames
balancing outdoor warmth with seated comfort instead of defaulting to Party or Office

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five golf friends, [X] chooses a dress theme whose lower garments still allow an afternoon on grass and around lawn games while making the group look intentionally coordinated for a playful social event.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为二十五位高尔夫球友筹办户外午宴时，[X]会挑选一种着装主题，使下装既适合在草地上活动和参加庭院游戏，又能让整组人在轻松社交聚会的合影中显得协调且经过准备。
examples: using Fitness/Sports when golf skirts, skorts, or shorts must retain movement and outdoor comfort
using Party when the same lower pieces carry a coordinated invitation theme and group-photo role
rejecting costume-like styling that prevents ordinary movement during the luncheon

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When [X] and a partner move a Venda-and-Tsonga family wedding to Dubai, the pair defines an interchangeable lower-body clothing role that works for a hot-weather arrival, formal rituals, culturally specific dancing, and the reception without obscuring the ceremonial clothing's cultural character.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]与伴侣把融合文达与聪加传统的家族婚礼改到迪拜举行时，需要确定一类可替换下装，使其能够应对炎热天气下的抵达、正式仪式、具有文化特点的舞蹈和婚宴，同时不掩盖仪式服装原有的文化特色。
examples: using Party for the ceremony and reception while preserving traditional lower-garment roles
using Vacation only for the travel and hot-destination transition, not as a substitute for ceremonial meaning
allowing movement during dancing without converting the outfit into generic sportswear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a casual afternoon class reunion on campus, [X] proposes familiar dark jeans with a sweater and classic clogs, then checks whether that exact lower half is polished enough for reconnecting with classmates without abandoning an everyday personal style.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加校园内举行的休闲午后同学聚会时，[X]打算用熟悉的深色牛仔裤搭配毛衣和经典洞洞鞋，并确认这一具体下半身组合是否足够利落，既适合与老同学重聚，又不偏离平日风格。
examples: using School for the campus and class-reunion context without treating it as a current uniform requirement
using Party for the social reunion while preserving the user's casual dress code
testing the proposed jeans rather than replacing the user's outfit with an unrelated formal recommendation

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before interviewing for a managerial role, [X] compares interchangeable dress trousers and chinos against the organization's expected formality, the need to look credible while seated and standing, and the risk of appearing either careless or unnecessarily ceremonial.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在参加管理岗位面试前，[X]会根据机构预期的正式程度、坐下和起身时都要显得可信，以及避免过于随便或过度隆重的风险，在正装裤与斜纹裤等可替换下装类别之间作选择。
examples: using Office for a managerial interview whose dress standard is business formal or strong business professional
keeping the lower garment conservative enough to support credibility without treating every workplace as identical
rejecting casual bottoms only when they conflict with the actual interview context

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a limited clothing budget, [X] builds a small lower-body wardrobe for long school days, walking between classes, casual time afterward, sports participation, presentations, and occasional internship needs, assigning each interchangeable bottom a real role before spending.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用有限预算规划下装衣橱时，[X]会面对漫长上课日、课间步行、放学后的休闲活动、体育参与、课堂展示和偶尔的实习需要，先为每类可替换下装分配真实用途，再决定如何花钱。
examples: using School for jeans, joggers, chinos, or skirts that survive a full day of classes and movement
using Fitness/Sports when after-class activity requires a different lower-body role
using Office only for presentation or internship needs that genuinely require more polish
